title: strength import
description: Result of `stride strength import <file|->` — strength workouts as Strava's MCP connector returns them (a list of workout objects, or one), each stored in strength_logs against its activity and parsed into strength_sets before the command returns, so `stride strength` shows them without an analyze. A stored log takes precedence over the activity's description for that activity, and re-importing an activity replaces its log. `imported` and `skipped` together hold one entry per workout in the input, in input order within each list. A skipped workout is not an error: the command exits 0 and names the reason, and only unreadable input or input that is not workout JSON fails the command.

imported.description: One entry per stored workout. `rows` counts the stored set rows (consecutive sets of one exercise at the same reps and weight fold into one row); `sets` counts the sets those rows hold.

skipped.description: One entry per workout left unstored. `activity_id` is the input's value as given, a string because a skipped id need not be numeric ("" when the workout carried none).

reason.description: bad_activity_id: absent, not a whole number, or not positive. unknown_activity: no activity with that id in the database (sync first). no_sets: no set with reps to store.
